## Translation notes

- [ ] No tashkeel (diacritical marks) in Arabic content
- [ ] English numerals used (not Arabic-Indic numerals)
- [ ] Formal MSA (Modern Standard Arabic)
- [ ] Meaning preserved — no interpretation, expansion, or simplification
- [ ] Technical terms follow the same convention used elsewhere in the repository

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the source-language document carefully before translating
- [ ] The translation preserves the same disclaimers and warnings

- [ ] Both files will have the same `verification_status` after this change
